Post-Surgery Pathological Response in Participants Receiving Surgery at
pCR Rate in Participants Receiving Surgery at C6D18, n(%)

Note: pCR is programmatically derived according to the definition in the protocol using Disease Staging – Post-Surgery data: pCR is defined as no invasive cancer in the breast and sampled axillary lymph nodes following completion of neoadjuvant systemic therapy (Pathologic Tumor - ypT = ypT0 or ypTis, and Pathologic Lymph Nodes – ypN = ypN0).pCR rate is the proportion of participants with pCR.
